spans_detail.liveEn: ::interactive widget="drag-match" id="which-standard-requires-it" concept_slugs="ia-audit-requirement-divergence-27001-42001,ia-management-review-input-divergence,ia-isms-competence-does-not-satisfy-aims-competence,ia-27001-42001-scope-overlap" { "items": [ { "id": "r1", "text": "Management review must consider feedback from interested parties and the status of the risk treatment plan." }, { "id": "r2", "text": "The organization must set the objectives, criteria and scope of each individual audit." }, { "id": "r3", "text": "A formal documented process assessing potential consequences for individuals, groups of individuals and societies." }, { "id": "r4", "text": "The organization must determine who shall monitor and measure, and who shall analyse and evaluate the results." } ], "targets": [ { "id": "t-27001-mr", "text": "ISO/IEC 27001 only - 42001's management review inputs do not include these" }, { "id": "t-42001-audit", "text": "ISO/IEC 42001 only - 27001 requires criteria and scope, not objectives" }, { "id": "t-42001-impact", "text": "ISO/IEC 42001 only - the AI system impact assessment, clause 6.1.4" }, { "id": "t-27001-91", "text": "ISO/IEC 27001 only - 42001's clause 9.1 has four items and neither names who" } ], "correct": { "r1": "t-27001-mr", "r2": "t-42001-audit", "r3": "t-42001-impact", "r4": "t-27001-91" }, "explanation": "Two run each way, which is the point. An auditor who assumes 42001 is 27001 with AI added will over-require on management review and clause 9.1, and under-require on per-audit objectives and the impact assessment. Every one of these is the same clause number in both standards, which is exactly why the differences are missed - the harmonised structure that makes integration practical also makes divergence invisible to anyone reading by clause number rather than by text." } ::
spans_detail.liveEs: ::interactive widget="drag-match" id="which-standard-requires-it" concept_slugs="ia-audit-requirement-divergence-27001-42001,ia-management-review-input-divergence,ia-isms-competence-does-not-satisfy-aims-competence,ia-27001-42001-scope-overlap" { "items": [ { "id": "r1", "text": "La revisión por la dirección debe considerar la retroalimentación de las partes interesadas y el estado del plan de tratamiento del riesgo." }, { "id": "r2", "text": "La organización debe definir los objetivos, criterios y alcance de la auditoría para cada auditoría." }, { "id": "r3", "text": "Un proceso formal documentado que evalúe las posibles consecuencias para individuos, grupos de individuos y sociedades." }, { "id": "r4", "text": "La organización debe determinar quién debe monitorear y medir, y quién debe analizar y evaluar los resultados." } ], "targets": [ { "id": "t-27001-mr", "text": "Solo ISO/IEC 27001 - las entradas de la revisión por la dirección de 42001 no incluyen estos elementos" }, { "id": "t-42001-audit", "text": "Solo ISO/IEC 42001 - 27001 requiere criterios y alcance, no objetivos" }, { "id": "t-42001-impact", "text": "Solo ISO/IEC 42001 - la evaluación de impacto del sistema de IA, apartado 6.1.4" }, { "id": "t-27001-91", "text": "Solo ISO/IEC 27001 - el apartado 9.1 de 42001 tiene cuatro elementos y ninguno nombra quién" } ], "correct": { "r1": "t-27001-mr", "r2": "t-42001-audit", "r3": "t-42001-impact", "r4": "t-27001-91" }, "explanation": "Dos van en cada dirección, que es precisamente el punto. Un auditor que asume que 42001 es 27001 con IA añadida exigirá de más en la revisión por la dirección y en el apartado 9.1, y exigirá de menos en los objetivos por auditoría y en la evaluación de impacto. Cada uno de estos elementos tiene el mismo número de capítulo en ambas normas, que es exactamente por qué se pasan por alto las diferencias: la estructura armonizada que hace viable la integración también hace invisible la divergencia para quien lee por número de capítulo en lugar de por el texto." } ::
spans_detail.livePt: ::interactive widget="drag-match" id="which-standard-requires-it" concept_slugs="ia-audit-requirement-divergence-27001-42001,ia-management-review-input-divergence,ia-isms-competence-does-not-satisfy-aims-competence,ia-27001-42001-scope-overlap" { "items": [ { "id": "r1", "text": "A análise crítica pela direção deve considerar o feedback das partes interessadas e o status do plano de tratamento de riscos." }, { "id": "r2", "text": "A organização deve definir os objetivos, critérios e escopo da auditoria para cada auditoria." }, { "id": "r3", "text": "Um processo formal documentado que avalia as potenciais consequências para indivíduos, grupos de indivíduos e sociedades." }, { "id": "r4", "text": "A organização deve determinar quem deve monitorar e medir, e quem deve analisar e avaliar os resultados." } ], "targets": [ { "id": "t-27001-mr", "text": "Somente ISO/IEC 27001 — as entradas da análise crítica pela direção da 42001 não incluem esses itens" }, { "id": "t-42001-audit", "text": "Somente ISO/IEC 42001 — a 27001 exige critérios e escopo, não objetivos" }, { "id": "t-42001-impact", "text": "Somente ISO/IEC 42001 — a avaliação de impacto do sistema de IA, Seção 6.1.4" }, { "id": "t-27001-91", "text": "Somente ISO/IEC 27001 — a Seção 9.1 da 42001 tem quatro itens e nenhum nomeia quem" } ], "correct": { "r1": "t-27001-mr", "r2": "t-42001-audit", "r3": "t-42001-impact", "r4": "t-27001-91" }, "explanation": "Dois seguem em cada direção, e esse é o ponto. Um auditor que assume que a 42001 é a 27001 com IA adicionada vai exigir demais na análise crítica pela direção e na Seção 9.1, e exigir de menos nos objetivos por auditoria e na avaliação de impacto. spans_detail.liveEn: ::checkpoint [ { "id": "q1", "question": "Which element of a nonconformity statement is most often missing, and what does its absence mean?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "The severity classification - without it the recipient cannot prioritise." }, { "id": "b", "text": "The named requirement - without it there is no nonconformity, only an observation about practice." }, { "id": "c", "text": "The recommended corrective action - without it the organization cannot respond." }, { "id": "d", "text": "The auditor's name - without it the finding cannot be queried." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "A nonconformity is a requirement not fulfilled, so a statement with no named requirement has not established one. The corrective action is the organization's to determine under clause 10.2; classification and attribution matter and neither determines whether a nonconformity exists.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-requirement-to-evidence-link", "ia-nonconformity-statement-structure"], "bloom_level": "3_apply", "difficulty": 3 }, { "id": "q2", "question": "Why should a nonconformity statement avoid speculating about the cause?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "Because auditors are not competent to identify causes." }, { "id": "b", "text": "Because clause 10.2 b) 2) makes determining the causes the organization's obligation, and an auditor's guess tends to become the organization's answer so the analysis never happens." }, { "id": "c", "text": "Because causes cannot be established from audit evidence." }, { "id": "d", "text": "Because it lengthens the statement unnecessarily." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "The corrective action process must determine causes, and a plausible cause offered by an auditor is very often adopted without analysis. Auditors frequently can see likely causes - the discipline is offering the observation as context rather than as part of the finding.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-statement-objectivity"], "bloom_level": "4_analyze", "difficulty": 4 }, { "id": "q3", "question": "An auditee disagrees with a finding and the disagreement is not resolved by the closing meeting. What does ISO 19011's fair presentation principle indicate?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "The finding should be withdrawn until agreement is reached." }, { "id": "b", "text": "Any disagreement between the audit team and the auditee that was left unresolved should be reported." }, { "id": "c", "text": "The finding should be downgraded to an observation." }, { "id": "d", "text": "The disagreement should be handled privately with the audit programme manager." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "Fair presentation names unresolved diverging opinions, alongside significant obstacles, as things that should be reported. The finding stands as the audit team's evaluation with the auditee's position recorded alongside; withdrawing or downgrading it to end a disagreement misrepresents what the audit found.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-statement-objectivity"], "bloom_level": "2_understand", "difficulty": 3 }, { "id": "q4", "question": "Which is the better test of a nonconformity statement?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "Whether the auditee accepts it." }, { "id": "b", "text": "Whether it could be disputed with evidence rather than only with an opinion." }, { "id": "c", "text": "Whether it identifies who was responsible." }, { "id": "d", "text": "Whether it is short enough to fit on one line." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "A statement built from a named requirement, specific evidence and a stated gap can be disputed by producing the missing records - which is exactly the right kind of challenge. Acceptance is not the test, responsibility is not the finding's subject, and length follows from the content.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-nonconformity-statement-structure"], "bloom_level": "3_apply", "difficulty": 3 } ] ::
spans_detail.liveEs: ::checkpoint [ { "id": "q1", "question": "¿Qué elemento del enunciado de una no conformidad falta con mayor frecuencia, y qué implica su ausencia?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "La clasificación de gravedad — sin ella el destinatario no puede priorizar." }, { "id": "b", "text": "El requisito nombrado — sin él no hay no conformidad, solo una observación sobre la práctica." }, { "id": "c", "text": "La acción correctiva recomendada — sin ella la organización no puede responder." }, { "id": "d", "text": "El nombre del auditor — sin él no se puede consultar el hallazgo." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "Una no conformidad es un requisito no cumplido, por lo que un enunciado sin un requisito nombrado no ha establecido ninguno. La acción correctiva corresponde a la organización determinarla según el capítulo 10.2; la clasificación y la atribución importan, pero ninguna determina si existe una no conformidad.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-requirement-to-evidence-link", "ia-nonconformity-statement-structure"], "bloom_level": "3_apply", "difficulty": 3 }, { "id": "q2", "question": "¿Por qué debe evitarse especular sobre la causa en el enunciado de una no conformidad?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "Porque los auditores no son competentes para identificar causas." }, { "id": "b", "text": "Porque el apartado 10.2 b) 2) asigna a la organización la obligación de determinar las causas, y la suposición de un auditor tiende a convertirse en la respuesta de la organización, de modo que el análisis nunca se realiza." }, { "id": "c", "text": "Porque las causas no pueden establecerse a partir de la evidencia de auditoría." }, { "id": "d", "text": "Porque alarga el enunciado innecesariamente." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "El proceso de acción correctiva debe determinar las causas, y una causa plausible ofrecida por un auditor es adoptada con mucha frecuencia sin análisis. Los auditores a menudo pueden ver causas probables — la disciplina consiste en ofrecer la observación como contexto y no como parte del hallazgo.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-statement-objectivity"], "bloom_level": "4_analyze", "difficulty": 4 }, { "id": "q3", "question": "Un auditado no está de acuerdo con un hallazgo y el desacuerdo no se resuelve en la reunión de cierre. ¿Qué indica el principio de presentación justa de ISO 19011?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "El hallazgo debe retirarse hasta que se alcance un acuerdo." }, { "id": "b", "text": "Las opiniones divergentes no resueltas entre el equipo auditor y el auditado deben ser informadas." }, { "id": "c", "text": "El hallazgo debe degradarse a una observación." }, { "id": "d", "text": "El desacuerdo debe gestionarse de forma privada con el responsable del programa de auditoría." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "La presentación justa nombra las opiniones divergentes no resueltas, junto con los obstáculos significativos, como aspectos que deben informarse. El hallazgo se mantiene como la evaluación del equipo auditor y la posición del auditado se registra junto a él; retirarlo o degradarlo para poner fin a un desacuerdo tergiversa lo que la auditoría encontró.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-statement-objectivity"], "bloom_level": "2_understand", "difficulty": 3 }, { "id": "q4", "question": "¿Cuál es la mejor prueba de un enunciado de no conformidad?", "type": "single_choice", "options": [ { "id": "a", "text": "Si el auditado lo acepta." }, { "id": "b", "text": "Si podría refutarse con evidencia y no solo con una opinión." }, { "id": "c", "text": "Si identifica al responsable." }, { "id": "d", "text": "Si es lo suficientemente breve para caber en una línea." } ], "correct": ["b"], "explanation": "Un enunciado construido a partir de un requisito nombrado, evidencia específica y una brecha declarada puede refutarse presentando los registros faltantes — que es exactamente el tipo de impugnación correcto. La aceptación no es la prueba, la responsabilidad no es el objeto del hallazgo, y la extensión se deriva del contenido.", "concept_slugs": ["ia-nonconformity-statement-structure"], "bloom_level": "3_apply", "difficulty": 3 } ] ::
